items.title: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
items.excerpt: Jensen Huang's relationship with a suspected Chinese spy has Congress ready to crack down, with lawmakers moving to tighten export rules on advanced AI chips to China.

items.title: Chinese AI labs are training models on Nvidia's Blackwell despite export controls, says ex-OpenAI engineer
items.excerpt: A forensic report by an ex-OpenAI engineer finds evidence that Chinese AI labs trained models on export-controlled Nvidia Blackwell chips.

items.title: DOJ takes aim at $1.2B in Binance loot as FBI disrupts North Korean scam
items.excerpt: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from the Binance hack; the FBI ties North Korea's 'FaceStealer' deepfake video-call scam to $400M+ in theft and 900+ webcam recordings.

items.title: 靑 "국가자격시험 전체 AI활용 부정행위 의심 사례 전수조사"
items.excerpt: 청와대가 세무사 시험 수석 합격자의 AI 이용 부정행위 논란과 관련해 긴급 대책회의를 열고 국가자격시험 전반의 AI 활용 부정행위 의심 사례를 전수조사하기로 했다.

items.title: "러트닉, 가족 회사와 연관된 반도체 수출규제 완화 추진"
items.excerpt: 하워드 러트닉 미 상무장관이 설립한 투자회사가 규제를 우회해 중국에 최첨단 AI 반도체가 흘러가는 구조와 연관된 가운데, 러트닉이 반도체 수출규제 완화를 추진했다는 NYT 보도.

items.title: 홍콩, AI 안면인식 감시망 가동…용의자 동선 실시간 추적
items.excerpt: 홍콩 경찰이 인공지능(AI)을 활용한 안면인식 감시망을 가동해 용의자 동선을 실시간으로 추적한다.

items.title: 정부, 올해 국가자격시험 전수조사 실시…세무사 시험 부정행위자는 5년간 응시 제한
items.excerpt: 고용노동부가 비상대책회의를 열고 올해 국가자격시험 AI 활용 부정행위 전수조사와 제63회 세무사 시험 부정행위자 합격 취소·5년 응시 제한 등 후속대책을 마련했다.

items.title: 중기부, '모두의 창업' 개인정보 유출 업체 제재 추진…AI 공급기업 긴급 보안점검
items.excerpt: 중기부가 '모두의 창업' 참가자 개인정보 유출 사고를 낸 민간 AI 솔루션 공급업체에 선정 취소 등 제재를 검토하고 나머지 AI 공급기업 긴급 보안점검에 나선다.

items.title: 美 의회, 엔비디아 압박 본격화…中 수출 통제 정조준
items.excerpt: 젠슨 황 사임 직후 미국 의회가 엔비디아와 황 전 CEO를 상대로 국가안보와 대중국 반도체 수출통제 문제를 따지는 조사에 착수했다.

items.title: 수능 코앞인데 AI 부정행위 파문…청와대, 국가자격시험 전수조사
items.excerpt: 세무사시험 수석합격자의 AI 부정행위 시인에 정부가 국가자격시험 전수조사에 나서고, 수능에서 AI 기기 점검 절차를 마련해 감독을 강화하기로 했다.

items.title: Art 'must not be sacrificed on the altar of corporate profit', Liberal senator says as AI policy debate rages
items.excerpt: Australian Liberal senator Andrew McLachlan urges the Labor government to consider AI's impact on artists and the environment.

items.title: Nvidia scandal: US treasury chief blames Lutnick's commerce department over alleged lack of action
items.excerpt: US commerce secretary faces sack as questions emerge over senior Trump officials' knowledge of the alleged Chinese spy's ties to Jensen Huang.

items.title: Bessent blames Lutnick's department for Nvidia chip sales to Megaspeed
items.excerpt: Scott Bessent told CNBC that several government agencies 'were in favour of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months'.

items.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
items.excerpt: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China despite US restrictions; Megaspeed says Alice Huang left in 2025.

items.title: Firm linked to Jensen Huang's ex-lover reportedly brokered nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for China
items.excerpt: Megaspeed arranged nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for Chinese companies between 2024 and 2025, according to the WSJ.

items.title: Convergent Interests: How America Could Undermine Its Own AI Advantage
items.excerpt: A convergence of political, commercial and ideological pressures can impede America's AI leadership, and public controversies are powerful enough to catalyze it.

items.title: AI Now Statement on the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act (BAAJA) to US Congress
items.excerpt: AI Now says BAAJA serves as a backdoor bailout of the AI industry and urges Congress to side with communities pursuing data center moratoria.

items.title: EU deal on Ukraine talks overshadows AI-focused summit in Dublin
items.excerpt: EU leaders' AI-focused informal summit in Dublin was overshadowed by agreement on the bloc's representation at future Ukraine peace negotiations.

items.title: How Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia impacts China's AI supply chain
items.excerpt: The founder's departure removes Beijing's biggest advocate in Silicon Valley, accelerates chip stockpiling, and leaves Asian suppliers bracing for what comes next.

items.title: The Download: Silicon Valley's blind spot and Nvidia's chip-tracking plan
items.excerpt: Newsletter item: Nvidia privately acknowledged it could implement location-tracking on AI chips to deter smuggling.
